实时场景离开图鉴范围；与读取信号失效分开记录。: The live scene left the gallery. Signal loss is logged separately.
图鉴中有效播放器正在播放，不依赖 HP、伤害回调或玩家对象可用。: A valid gallery event player is playing, without requiring HP damage or a valid player character.
播放器停止、身份变化或读取失效；不把播放器名字当作唯一 CG 编号。: The player stopped, changed identity or lost its signal. Player names are not unique CG IDs.
区分游戏暂停、演出内部等待和时间停止；内部等待不等同手动暂停。: Game pause, internal waits and stopped time are distinct; internal waits do not prove manual pause.
心跳过期或会话不可用；不据此声称用户已退出图鉴。: The heartbeat expired or session became unavailable. This does not prove gallery exit.
独立读取怪物 ID 与 [1]/[2]/[3]；选择按钮先变化，实际片段可能稍后: Reads monster ID and [1]/[2]/[3] independently. Selection may change before the new take loads.
独立读取实际 Take 名称和身份，与选择按钮变化分开；返回列表后忽略残留指针。: Reads the actual Take name/identity separately from button selection. Stale pointers are ignored after list return.
图鉴按钮面板关闭或片段索引为负数；保留的旧 Take 指针不表示仍在播放。: The guide closed or clip index is negative. A retained Take pointer does not mean playback continues.
独立读取图鉴 Stop、慢放、DevMode 和隐藏界面的开关，不从演出内部等待: Reads Stop, slow playback, DevMode and UI-hidden flags directly, independently of internal event waits.
演出中重复的新鲜伤害通知，HP 前后相同；不使用普通快照、MP 变化或历史事件。: Repeated fresh damage callbacks during a scene report unchanged HP. Snapshots, MP and history are excluded.
演出结束或同值通知断流；超时可在 CG 页调整。: The scene ended or same-HP callbacks stopped. Set the timeout on the CG page.
GO 场景身份匹配、实时演出播放且显示 1 HP；允许没有玩家对象的 CG 使用: A recognized GO scene is playing at 1 HP. A player object is optional; cached statuses are not used.
GO 演出停止、显示值不再为 1 HP、退出场景或心跳失效；停止这条演出反馈。: Stops when GO playback ends, HP differs from 1, the scene changes or the heartbeat expires.
有效玩家处于抓取 / 演出，8 秒内两次独立的 1→1、扣血 0 伤害回调；沿用: A valid grabbed/scene player receives two separate 1→1 zero-damage callbacks in 8 s. Uses death feedback.
恢复生命、离开互动或切换玩家 / 场景后清除判据；残留异常按独立策略处理。: Healing, interaction exit, player or scene changes clear the evidence. Remaining statuses use their own rules.
实时玩家 HP=1、流程正在播放、可挣扎标志生效且阈值有效；不要求重复扣血回调，: At HP1, the sequence is playing and struggle is active with a valid threshold. Uses CG feedback without requiring damage callbacks.
成功回血、离开流程或玩家身份失效后停止这段惩罚；零血及独立 GO 按各自规则继续: Stops on recovery, sequence exit or invalid player identity. Zero-HP and independent GO rules remain separate.
猪棚挣扎、失败分支和战败转场；沿用战败渐强规则。: Pigpen struggle, failure branches and defeat transitions use the defeat ramp strategy.
猪棚场景 167 Event / Main；正血量也继续战败反馈，返回正常游戏后: Pigpen scene 167 Event/Main keeps defeat feedback at positive HP and stops when normal play resumes.
猪棚 Continue / Success；停止战败持续反馈，挣脱本身不触发输出: Pigpen Continue/Success ends continuous defeat feedback. Escaping itself does not trigger output.
记录播放器对象名、类型和触发器；请求不等于已进入战败 CG。: Records object name, type and trigger. A request does not prove a defeat CG has started.
记录同步流程标签及执行组件；异步专用路径仍需对照。: Records synchronous labels and executing components. Asynchronous paths need further comparison.
记录停止调用，真实演出结束以新鲜播放器状态为准。: Records a stop call; fresh player state determines actual playback completion.
来源确认是当前玩家、敌人实际 HP 下降；记录实际伤害和剩余 HP。: The current player is confirmed as the source and enemy HP dropped. Logs actual damage and remaining HP.
敌人由存活进入死亡，并关联同一生命周期的玩家致命伤害；HP 归零本身不计击杀。: An alive enemy became dead and is linked to a fatal player hit in the same lifecycle. HP0 alone is not a kill.
实际 HP 下降，但来源无法确认是玩家；保留来源类名以便实测。: Enemy HP dropped, but the player is not confirmed as the source. Retains source class names.
已进入死亡状态，但缺少玩家致命伤害证据；场景清理不计入。: Death was detected without evidence of a fatal player hit. Scene cleanup is excluded.
HP 前后值、HP / MP 消耗；−1 为未提供，不能当成回血。: HP before/after and HP/MP costs. −1 means unavailable, not healing.
敌人类名、是否替换抓取者。: Enemy class and whether it replaced the captor.
释放时敌人和 HP；相邻的重复释放回调合并。: Enemy and HP at release; adjacent duplicate callbacks are merged.
本次抓取内挣扎达标、随后脱困且存活；精确原因仍待回调验证。: Struggle reached its threshold, then release occurred while alive. Exact cause still needs callback confirmation.
broken 标志变化，并显示耐久；进入时已破损只显示当前状态。: The broken flag changed; durability is shown. Starting already broken only shows current state.
同一玩家由正数降至 0；不能据此认定 Game Over。: The same player's HP dropped from positive to zero. This does not prove Game Over.
同一玩家、同一场景 HP 上升；角色重绑不计回血。: HP rose for the same player and scene; rebinding the player is not healing.
状态类型、请求等级；实际生效等级以顶部状态栏为准。: Status type and requested level. The live status panel shows the effective level.
已安装观察钩子；是否走这条路径需逐敌人验证。: The hook is installed; usage of this path needs per-enemy testing.

对比实际异常列表，区分新增、移除和等级变化。: Compares actual status lists to distinguish additions, removals and level changes.
游戏暂停标志变化；暂停期间继续显示插件心跳。: The game pause flag changed. Heartbeats remain visible while paused.
标识读取对象变化，不自动称为复活。: The observed object changed; this is not automatically labeled revival.

仅使用 CG 播放信号：优先核对共享 Animator 与动画状态，并要求有效演: CG playback signals only: checks shared Animator states within a valid sequence. HP, grab and status fallbacks are excluded. Changing mode pauses output.

请先保存并退出游戏；导入前自动备份。不会随插件安装自动导入。: Save and exit the game first. A backup is made before import. Plugin installation never imports this save automatically.
若导入后继续游玩导致存档变化，自动撤销会停止，请通过备份手动恢复。: If later gameplay changes the save, automatic undo is blocked. Restore manually from the backup instead.
